label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input 'param' flows to 'host'. Although 'resolveHost' validates the IP address type before the fetch (lines 39-40), the subsequent 'openConnection()' call (line 43) triggers a second DNS resolution of the hostname. This creates a time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerability. An attacker can perform DNS rebinding, changing the DNS record between the validation and the fetch, allowing them to reach internal/private resources (e.g., cloud metadata) while passing the initial check. The resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled input.

evidence.note: Pre-validation resolves host to IP and checks if non-public.
Actual fetch opens connection, triggering re-resolution of 'host'.
